forbidden.name: device-not-cloud
forbidden.comment: Device JS entry points and bindings (under expo/) must not import cloud code via any path: Metro does not tree-shake, so imported cloud code would be bundled into mobile apps.

forbidden.name: core-not-features
forbidden.comment: Core code must not import pluggable features (under src/features/: checksums, exports): the core defines interfaces, while cloud features are wired by the entry assembly root (cloudflare/index.ts) and device features live in the Rust core. The core works completely without them (only tests verifying checksums wire them).

forbidden.name: no-circular
forbidden.comment: Circular dependencies obscure load order and test boundaries.

forbidden.name: product-not-tools
forbidden.comment: Product code must not import gates or development scripts: tools/ is strictly for development.
